cohort: Mothers with singleton live births from the Obstetrical Care Outcomes Assessment Program database (N = 72,697)
finding: Pre-pregnancy overweight/obesity status modifies associations of race/ethnicity with pregnancy complications, and conversely, race/ethnicity modifies associations of pre-pregnancy overweight/obesity status with pregnancy complications.
mod_finding: Among women with overweight/obesity, Hispanics had a lower risk of cesarean delivery compared to NH White women.
